issues.on_page: Allocation from General Fund: Depreciation 100,000.00 (p16), Employee Benefit 22,375.20 (p17); printed as a receipt in Exhibit III (p6) and as a General Receipt in Exhibit II (p4)
issues.issue: Step 3b check: no matching General Fund outflow can be found. Schedule M (pp23-30) itemizes every GF program by object, each program ties to Schedule B (pp14-15), and the only transfer lines are 8000 Transfers (Nutrition 57,100 + Activity 48,000 = 105,100). No object line is an allocation/transfer and there is no elimination column, so a hidden transfer can't be identified without guessing (no spending line was split, which is correct). The GF roll-forward ties without it (1,200,148.46 + 4,531,369.84 - 4,795,398.66 = 936,119.64, p9/p11) and the totals tie, so the report itself adds up. Because total cash ties, the 122,375.20 is either real outside cash put straight into these funds (in which case it is really revenue) or it sits unidentified inside GF spending (in which case spending is double counted by that amount). Recording it as other_financing is an assumption. The extractor already put this in decision_needed, so it stays a warning.
